title: Mavci control state
description: CONTROL PLANE. Written only by state.mjs. Agents are denied Edit on .mavci/control/**. THREE VERSION FACTS, THREE FIELDS: ci_pinned_plugin_version is the tag CI clones and moves only by an operator act (--init, doctor --sync); written_by_plugin_version is stamped by setState on every write and answers 'which version wrote this document'; plugin_version is the pre-0.1.22 field that meant all three at once and is accepted on read so already-connected projects stay valid - it is never written, and the first write migrates it.
